pr_title: Forward Setting Changes to ApplicationVolumeHandling class
pr_body:
## Description
The OnSettingChanged callback needs to be forwarded to the volume handling class.

## Motivation and context
Fixes #21915

## How has this been tested?
1. Play a song that is tagged with both track gain and album gain
2. Change the ReplayGain mode
3. Play the same song again
4. Verify in the ReplayGain log statement that the setting change in step 2 took effect

## What is the effect on users?
Bug fix

issue_context.title: Replaygain settings not applied until Kodi restart
issue_context.body:
<!--- Please fill out this template to the best of your ability. You can always edit this issue once you have created it. -->
<!--- Read the following link before you create a new problem report: https://kodi.wiki/view/HOW-TO:Submit_a_bug_report  -->
## Bug report
### Describe the bug
Here is a clear and concise description of what the problem is:
<!--- Provide a more detailed introduction to the issue itself, and why you consider it to be a bug -->
<!--- A bug report that is not clear will be closed -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
When user changes replaygain settings on Settings -> Player -> Music -> Volume Adjustments (advanced)
guisettings.xml is updated with proper rpg type (0/1/2) (None/Album/Track) however, the updated setting is not used when playing a song.  Restarting Kodi does use the updated setting.  This appears to be a regression from PR #21449 @notspiff



## Expected Behavior
Here is a clear and concise description of what was expected to happen:
<!--- Tell us what should happen -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
Changing the Replaygain settings should take effect with the next playing song.  Confirmed in 20220522 nightly (prior to 21449)



## Actual Behavior
<!--- Tell us what happens instead -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
Stale replaygain settings continue to be used.



## Possible Fix
<!--- Not obligatory, but suggest a fix or reason for the bug -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
revert commit 43323255b9f130f2fe811f8dc2608430191d7adc
In testing I see that replaygain is set in CAudioDecoder GetReplayGain
That in turn calls g_application.GetReplayGainSettings()
which access some variable "quick" in GlobalHandlings.h
That variable has CApplicationVolumeHandling member m_replayGainSettings which appears to not be updated after changing settings.  That in turn gets returned to GetReplayGain resulting in wrong rpg values being calculated and used.


### To Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
<!--- Provide a link to a live example, or an unambiguous set of steps to -->
<!--- reproduce this bug. Include code to reproduce, if relevant -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
1. Create a song with replaygain track/track peak/album/album peak values in tags
2. Scan the track into the library 
3. Play song (default setting is to use album replaygain 1)
4. Enter settings and change player/music/ volume adjustment to use track replaygain 2
5. Play song again
6. Observe rpg data in kodi.log -- both plays use the album rpg data
7. Exit Kodi and restart
8. Play song again
9. Observe rpg data in kodi.log -- play now uses the track rpg data


### Debuglog

<!--- A debuglog is always mandatory when creating an issue. Provide one! -->
The debuglog can be found here:
